description: Main window: local content, snapshot autosync (fs writes to the sync folder, dialog to pick it), and two http destinations and no others — the Schreib-Assistent's local Ollama, and the cloud sync API. The sync origin is here because the webview cannot reach the session cookie across origins, so the desktop authenticates with a device token through the Rust-side http plugin (src/lib/sync-remote.ts).
